fields.System.Title: INV-501 — Reserve stock for an order line
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want stock promised to a specific order line and held, so that no
other order can be promised the same unit.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given available stock, when I reserve a quantity, then qty_reserved increases by
  • that amount, availability decreases, and a reservation row links it to the order line.
  • - Given a request for more than is available, then the reservation is rejected — never
  • partially applied silently.
  • - Given the balance row, then it is locked and availability re-checked under the lock
  • before the reservation is written.
  • - Given twenty concurrent reservations of one unit against ten units, then exactly ten
  • succeed.
  • - Given any point in time, then the sum of reservation rows equals qty_reserved on the
  • balance.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, reservation |
| Risks | Double allocation ([doc 09 §4.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); divergence ([doc 09 §2.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · concurrency (mandatory) · invariant |
